title: Sector-specific CII categorization overlay for the rocket and space industry

act.effective_date_note: The act states no special commencement rule; 2026-04-09 is derived from first official publication on 2026-04-01 and the general seven-day rule.

governance_rules.rule: Applies to information systems, telecommunication networks and industrial control systems functioning in the rocket and space industry and lawfully owned or operated by CII subjects.
Defines sector-specific establishment and calculation of significance indicators for assigning a CII category.
Categorization uses article 7 of Federal Law 187-FZ, PP 127 base rules and indicator thresholds, and this overlay together.
The subject head creates a permanent categorization commission under PP 127 clauses 11-13; its work is governed by the subject's internal normative act.
Identify the CII objects to be categorized and the processes whose disruption or termination may disrupt or terminate operation of those objects.
When interaction channels between different systems are identified, the subject may decide to combine those systems into one CII object.
When CII objects are modernized, the subject may decide to divide an object into several separate CII objects.

assessment_rules.rule: Determine the object's participation in its owner's processes and in processes performed for or belonging to another CII subject.
Determine the object's participation in performing or supporting the subject's state defence order.
Assess the probability of object disruption or termination if a computer incident occurs.
Assess the scale of consequences from object disruption or termination if a computer incident occurs.

negative_delta_rule.interpretation_guard: The act states that t_maintenance is used as the calculation basis; do not silently replace this with zero or invent a transformed formula.
The act states that t_maintenance is used as the calculation basis; do not silently replace this with zero or invent a transformed formula.

calculation_rules.rule: Use the defence-industry sector overlay for calculation; PP 356 does not reproduce or replace those calculation rules.

guardrails: Do not route this overlay outside proven rocket and space industry object facts.
Do not omit Federal Law 187-FZ or PP 127 base categorization requirements.
Clauses 6 and 7 permit consolidation or division by subject decision but do not require either action.
Clause 8 creates a Roscosmos document route after category assignment but states no number of hours or days.
Roscosmos is excluded from positions 1 and 11 under clauses 9(a) and 9(c), but not from positions 8 and 9 under clause 9(b).
Positions 13 and 13^1 have different state-defence-order role boundaries and must not be merged.
The five-year window in clause 12 and three-year window in clause 13 are calculation lookbacks, not evidence-retention periods.
Do not convert the negative-delta fallback wording into a zero clamp or a new formula not stated by the act.
Do not invent position 13 or 13^1 formulas: clause 15 delegates calculation to the defence-industry sector overlay.
No category is proven until complete facts and the applicable PP 127 threshold comparison are documented.
